name: Aldori Dueling Disciple
prerequisites: Exotic Weapon Proficiency (Aldori dueling sword), Weapon Finesse, Weapon Focus (Aldori dueling sword)
benefit:
You gain a +2 morale bonus on Intimidate checks to demoralize opponents, and the DC of any attempt to demoralize you increases by 2. When you’re participating in a duel, these bonuses increase to +4.
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Weapon Master's Handbook pg. 24
During any combat that is not a duel, you can spend 1 stamina point at the start of your turn to treat the combat as a duel until the start of your next turn for the purpose of gaining the benefits of the Aldori Dueling Discipline feat.
flavor: Your prowess in Aldori swordplay grants you bravado.
